source: Hopper provides very high tensor-core throughput for ZXNAME0000XZ. Simply converting all attention operands to ZXNAME0001XZ, however, can produce unacceptable numerical error because attention combines dot products, exponentials, normalization, and value accumulation over dynamic ranges that vary by tile.
zh: Hopper 为 ZXNAME0000XZ 提供非常高的张量核心吞吐量。然而，简单地将所有注意力操作数转换为 ZXNAME0001XZ 可能会产生不可接受的数值错误，因为注意力结合了点积、指数、归一化和随图块变化的动态范围内的值累积。
